text:
maria_g: Heads-up — deploy-bot will start enforcing the pin/unpin policy during tomorrow's 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. If a PR unpins a runtime or core package it will be flagged for manual review.

sam_k: Quick Q — what exactly counts as an 'unpin' for the bot? bumping a lockfile entry vs removing a version constraint?

maria_g: Good question. For the bot: 'unpin' = any PR that changes a pinned version field in package manifests (package.json/go.mod/requirements.txt) to a looser spec (e.g., `==1.2.3` -> `^1.2.0` or `>=1.2.0`). Simple dependency version bumps (patch/minor) are fine if still pinned or explicit.

liz_r: Proposal: enforce patch-only auto-approvals for deps-only PRs. Any behavioral change (runtime flags, config defaults) gets manual review and requires `release:minor` or `release:major` label.

jonah_m: How do we surface this in the deploy flow? Can deploy-bot add a label and prevent the release tag if not approved?

deploy-bot: scan: found 3 PRs altering pinned constraints. Action: applied label `needs-pin-review` to PRs #3421, #3456, #3469. To bypass add comment `/deploy allow-unpin @approver` or get manual approval.

sam_k: I'd rather avoid one-off bypasses. Suggest we accept a controlled bypass via canary + auto-rollback if errors appear. Means: allow `allow-unpin` but require `canary=true` and `rollback-on-error=true` CI flags.

maria_g: Agree with canary+rollback approach for low-risk cases. For anything touching runtime or infra packages we keep strict manual approval.

liz_r: Also want a clear tagging convention in commit messages so release notes are machine-readable. Suggest: include `release:patch`, `release:minor`, or `release:hotfix` in the PR title. We then generate tags like `r/v1.4.7+patch` or `r/v1.4.8-hotfix`.

jonah_m: Slight nit: semver doesn't like pre/suffixes for numeric comparison. Maybe use annotated tags `r/v1.4.7` and add a lightweight tag object `meta:hotfix` in the tag message body. Keeps git tooling happy.

maria_g: Good point. Let's standardize: annotated tag `r/vX.Y.Z` for the released commit. In the release notes header include `type: patch|minor|hotfix` from PR title label. That keeps tags comparable and notes machine-friendly.

sam_k: What about rollback criteria? I've seen rollbacks get blocked by partial DB migrations. Need a checklist.

maria_g: We'll add a short checklist for rollbacks in docs: 1) Confirm rollback tag exists and is bootstrapable. 2) Validate migrations are reversible or absent. 3) Notify SRE + Product. 4) Trigger rollback via `/deploy rollback r/vX.Y.Z` and set `--no-migrate` if needed.

deploy-bot: note: added deploy command help: ``/deploy rollback <tag> [--no-migrate]``. Will require explicit `confirm` comment from a member of `eng-sre` in open window.

liz_r: Can we also auto-generate a short release note fragment from PR titles with `release:` prefix? Saves on manual release notes.

maria_g: Yes — we'll have the release generator pull `release:` lines and aggregate under the annotated tag. Ops: update PR template to remind authors.

sam_k: Sounds reasonable. One last ask: please make sure the bot logs flagged PR reasons in the PR checklist so reviewers see why it was blocked.

maria_g: Will do. I'll push the PR template update and a small deploy-bot tweak before the change window. If anyone's planning unpinning work, ping me today so we can triage. :eyes:
